paths.checked_artifact: Original QLV1 packet: QIRF artifact and optional finite request; source lowering and evidence generation produce these bytes

paths.proof_scope: Qleisli.NativeValidity.check_sound and check_scopeSafe bind native packet success to ordinary-root VerifiedMeaning and classical scope. Protocol.Validity.check_acceptance/check_ownershipSafe bind the parsed packet and ownership.

paths.checked_artifact: QLV1 QIRF plus qleisli.native-contract request: encoded contract or leaf signature/ports/exact matrix
paths.checker: Main --qirf-contract -> Cli.runValidity true -> Protocol.NativeContract.check -> Qirf.checkContract (encoded), or Validity.checkRoot and Qirf.check (leaf)
paths.proof_scope: Protocol.NativeContract.check_acceptance binds original QLV1 body/request bytes, decoded artifact and request, and continuous checking states. Qleisli.NativeContract.check_root_meaning and check_sound establish RootMeaning for both request kinds. For leaf requests, leaf_meaning establishes original-body instrument meaning for the bounded closed unitary fragment, exact requested matrix/signature/ordered ports, and an actual verification of the output port; leaf_reference_laws extends both whole-space inverse laws to any finite reference. For encoded requests, check_encoded_sound and encoded_meaning bind the original root BodyMeaning, exact Basis interface and Encoded equation; Wrapper.circuitMatrix_entries proves actual wrapper coefficients equal the original reconstructed matrix, including zero-width phase and axis order. encoded_reference extends the equation to every reference amplitude function.
paths.gaps: This separate protocol does not inherit NativeValidity.check_sound. General EffectSound/CPTP, source/compiler preservation, deployed-binary correspondence, Rust rematerialization, target/runtime preservation, clean-release and quantitative RS claims remain separate. These bridge theorems are not a new guarantee admission or S05 closure.
